payload.title: KDE Plots
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook is designed to reproduce figures from an interval statistics analysis using BChron age models, focusing on median interval values. It requires pre-existing pickle files generated from previous notebooks. The notebook utilizes various Python libraries to load data, sort it by latitude, and apply interval statistic techniques. The outputs include visualizations of the interval statistics using Kernel Density Estimation (KDE) plots.
goals: Reproduce figures from interval statistics analysis using BChron age models.
Apply interval statistic techniques to median interval values.
